tools.name: check
tools.description: Run an approved public command by index in a disposable copy.

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Discover qualified symbols and read bounded source (60 lines, 3000 UTF-8 bytes). Use query to find a name/text or symbol=Class.method to jump. Follow next_line; unchanged repeated excerpts are suppressed.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Review a Git diff of current workspace edits.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Apply a SHORT exact source edit with current SHA-256 from focus. Modes replace/before/after require a unique literal old anchor, preserving all whitespace; new text is literal, including line endings. No fuzzy matching. create requires expected_sha256=absent and old empty. Errors return a source-region hint; reinspect and recover. Python results must parse.

limitation: Server health/catalog verified; upstream asynchronous registration is not guaranteed by this preflight.
